reviews.question: Make a two-row table for Vega’s spaced-retrieval and rereading groups, report each recall percentage, calculate the difference in percentage points, and name the measured outcome.
reviews.answer:
Spaced retrieval participants recalled 72%. [fixture 02, p. 1](nodus://review-source/review-a09cdf7f494d90f0a68ccc73/1)

Rereading participants recalled 51%. [fixture 02, p. 1](nodus://review-source/review-a09cdf7f494d90f0a68ccc73/1)

Calculation: 72% − 51% = 21 percentage points. [fixture 02, p. 1](nodus://review-source/review-a09cdf7f494d90f0a68ccc73/1)

The measured outcome was recall, reported as the percentage participants recalled. [fixture 02, p. 1](nodus://review-source/review-a09cdf7f494d90f0a68ccc73/1)

| Group | Recall |
| --- | --- |
| Spaced retrieval | 72% [fixture 02, p. 1](nodus://review-source/review-a09cdf7f494d90f0a68ccc73/1) |
| Rereading | 51% [fixture 02, p. 1](nodus://review-source/review-a09cdf7f494d90f0a68ccc73/1) |
